title: Zero-credit quality correction
summary: The stable zero-credit core now fixes rolling-caption inflation and separates deterministic interpretation from source receipts instead of repeating transcript blocks.
discord_changes: WPM FIX: rolling captions are deduplicated before pace is calculated, so impossible 692-WPM results are no longer trusted.
SUMMARY FIX: evidence mode now explains each beat and keeps the exact source sentence underneath as a receipt instead of presenting the transcript as the insight.
STILL ZERO CREDITS: one clean shell, 17-section Monday Brief, bounded progress and no paid model endpoints.
changes: Added cross-segment rolling-caption overlap removal plus repeated-caption block collapse before any pacing or evidence interpretation.
Recomputed WPM from the normalized caption word stream and actual video duration rather than inheriting the old backend pacing number.
Rebuilt re-hook, payoff and extraction candidates from the normalized transcript so repeated caption windows do not contaminate downstream sections.
Replaced transcript-style fallback summary cards with deterministic beat interpretation plus a separate timestamped evidence receipt.
Replaced raw takeaway repetition with distinct deterministic lessons linked back to an exact timestamped source receipt.
Preserved the exact 17-section 07/09/26 Monday Brief order and zero-credit local-model option for sections 2, 3, 14 and 16.
The live shell still loads one external entry script only; legacy interface layers remain outside the production boot path.
known_limitations: No-credit YTIntel cannot guarantee Claude Max/GPT-5.6-class reasoning. When a ready browser-local model is unavailable, the report uses deterministic interpretation and labels it accordingly.
The deterministic fallback is deliberately more analytical than transcript replay, but it is not equivalent to a premium cloud research agent.
Motion graphics and acoustic sound-design claims remain withheld when actual source frames/audio are unavailable.
Automated browser acceptance does not replace every physical iPhone/Android configuration.
why_it_matters: A zero-credit product is only useful if the numbers are sane and the insight is visibly separate from the source evidence.
